title: shipped a website refresh and a new media upload service
summary: added grok-imagine support and custom voice IDs for elevenlabs. also taught the video pipeline to handle rejection (better rate limit fallbacks). 14 PRs merged

highlights.title: Media Uploads
highlights.text: New `media.pollinations.ai` service. Upload up to 10MB, get a hash, keep your app's assets persistent.

highlights.title: Grok-Imagine
highlights.text: Added `grok-imagine` (alpha). xAI's latest visual model is now available for generation.

highlights.title: Custom Voices
highlights.text: Audio API now accepts custom ElevenLabs voice IDs. Bring your own clones instead of just using presets.

highlights.title: Website Refresh
highlights.text: Complete redesign with a new "flywheel" narrative and clearer [contributor tiers](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
